The '''Survival Kit''' was a [[Survival kit/Legends|survival knapsack]] manufactured by [[Chedak Communications]]. The kit was full of emergency survival supplies that [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] needed in case of emergencies. These packs included two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] [[Ration pack/Legends|rations]], three [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], two [[Flare/Legends|flares]], a [[di-chrome]] shelter, [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]], six [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]], a [[Knife/Legends|knife]], and a [[portable fusion generator]].<ref name="PSG" />
